subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a shortened form of Daz'issin, a softening name mothers use for boys they wish to live, and is not commonly used in the past three centuries.

subject: Menzoberranzan
fact: Menzoberranzan teaches individuals to read rooms and watch for the moment when someone's body stops matching their words.
source_quote: Menzoberranzan teaches you to read rooms. It teaches you to watch for the moment when someone's body stops matching their words.

subject: Geography and Cities, Menzoberranzan, Pillars of Woe
fact: A two-hundred-year-old heraldry book with a mechanically removed appendix that referenced a footnote about Daz'issin.
source_quote: Geography and Cities, Menzoberranzan, Pillars of Woe. Two hundred years old, give or take. The footnote referenced an appendix. The appendix was missing. I looked at the cut. It was mechanical. A razor.

subject: removal of appendix from Geography and Cities, Menzoberranzan, Pillars of Woe
fact: Someone used a razor at least fifty years ago to remove the appendix referenced by a footnote about Daz'issin, indicating deliberate erasure of information.
source_quote: A razor, at least fifty years ago, someone had taken to this book and removed what the footnote pointed to.

subject: library with all the information in the world
fact: A library that, by reputation, holds all the information in the world, yet contains something that should be here but is not, indicating a deliberate act of omission.
source_quote: This is a library with, by reputation, all the information in the world. Something is not here that should be here.

subject: struck fourth seat in Menzoberranzan
fact: The fourth seat holds ritual archive privileges in Menzoberranzan, and when struck, it is not merely a political erasure but an expensive, infrastructure-dependent act requiring knowledge of the right people and payment that leaves no trace.
source_quote: The fourth seat holds ritual archive privileges in Menzoberranzan — that having archive privileges means having the legal apparatus to access and alter records. That a struck fourth seat was not merely a political erasure. It was the expensive kind. The kind that requires knowing the right people and paying the right price and having the infrastructure to make the payment look like it was never made.

subject: Yvenne
fact: Yvenne maintains a practiced stillness inconsistent with her words, indicating she knows more than the public record allows her to say and is carefully navigating rather than simply informing.
source_quote: Yvenne's body had been disagreeing with her words for the last five minutes. The practiced stillness of someone who knows more than the public record allows her to say, maintaining the pose of a person who is simply informing rather than carefully navigating.

subject: erasure of houses that used the name Daz'issin
fact: Most houses that used the name Daz'issin did not last, suggesting systemic suppression or destruction linked to the name's use.
source_quote: The houses that had used it, most of them, did not last.

subject: room where public record is sealed
fact: The room contains a sealed public record, and the person within it is the current embodiment of that record, unable to speak of what is forbidden.
source_quote: The public record is sealed, and she is today the public record.

subject: Daz's realization of possible maternal naming
fact: Daz realizes his name may have been given by his mother as a softening form — Daz'issin — intended to ensure his survival, and that this naming may be connected to a suppressed lineage.
source_quote: Well, isn't my name, Daz? Maybe it's my full name? I asked whether someone might call me Daz, and this was actually a name that, like, my mother used.
